label: ASSUMPTION (diagnostic) - W29 13C-MFA flux bounds used as WT-state caps
applied_as: In-memory linear constraints for the Task B step-5 calibration diagnostic only. Never written to model XML; not a screen condition; not used for knockout calls.
cap_form: sum_i(coefficient_i * v_i) <= fraction * substrate_uptake, where substrate_uptake = -v(exchange) (the actual uptake flux).

source.paper: Worland AM et al. 2024 Metab Eng 85:1-13 doi:10.1016/j.ymben.2024.06.010; link between the repository and the paper inferred, pending user confirmation
source.units: MFA fluxes per 100 mol substrate with 95 % confidence bounds (<substrate>_LB / <substrate>_UB columns); fraction = bound / 100
source.medium_caveat: The MFA medium was not checked against the paper's methods; these runs use the PO1f + CSM-Leu medium chosen by the user.

pyruvate_carboxylase.module_note: R690 is the only carboxylation of pyruvate to oxaloacetate; R_OAADCm (matrix) is bounded to the decarboxylation direction only.

net_malate_import.definition: Net matrix malate gained through every cytosol<->matrix carrier, i.e. the signed coefficient of m538[C_mi] in each: R807 2-oxoadipate/malate, R831 citrate/malate, R902 malate/phosphate, R1386 2-oxoglutarate/malate. Upper bound only, as specified.

glycine_cleavage_R361_as_specified.mfa_row: R51 net (CO2 + MTHF + NADH <-> GLY): cleavage is the reverse direction, so the cleavage cap is -<substrate>_LB
glycine_cleavage_R361_as_specified.looser_fraction_note: <substrate>_UB of R51 net, i.e. the glycine-synthesis side of the MFA interval, not a cleavage bound. The earlier run used 0.009 for glucose.
glycine_cleavage_R361_as_specified.warning: R361 is the dihydrolipoamide dehydrogenase step (NAD + dihydrolipoamide -> NADH + lipoamide). In this model it also re-oxidizes the dihydrolipoamide made by 2-oxoglutarate dehydrogenase (R614 -> R613), the only matrix 2-OGDH route, so capping R361 also caps 2-OGDH. Glycine cleavage can bypass R361 through R357 (lumped) and R362-R364 (lipoylprotein).

glycine_cleavage_module.definition: Every glycine-consuming entry step of the three parallel glycine-cleavage representations (lumped R357; lipoamide R360-R365-R361; lipoylprotein R362-R363-R364). Added because rule 1 of the task requires listing all parts of a redundant module.
